ov: الدولة الكبيرة (الإنجليزية: The Big Country) هو فيلم صدر في سنة 1958. الفيلم من إخراج وليام وايلر.
plotEn:
Former sea captain James McKay travels to the American West to join his fiancée Patricia Terrill at the enormous ranch owned by her father, Henry "the Major" Terrill. After a meeting with Patricia's friend, schoolteacher Julie Maragon, McKay and Patricia are accosted by a group of drunks led by Buck Hannassey, the son of the Major's implacable enemy, Rufus Hannassey. The Major and Rufus have a longstanding, destructive feud over water access for cattle. Despite the harassment and mockery, McKay surprises Patricia by making light of the incident, stating that he has experienced worse hazing, and the drunken boys meant no harm.
The next morning, McKay declines an invitation from foreman Steve Leech to ride an indomitable bronco stallion named "Old Thunder", noting that the infatuated Leech is counting on him to fail in Patricia's eyes. Patricia expresses disappointment that McKay did not participate in the Ladder Ranch tradition of attempting to ride Old Thunder. McKay presents a pair of dueling pistols once owned by his father to the Major as a gift. When the Major learns of Buck's harassment the previous day, he gathers his men and raids the Hannassey ranch, despite McKay's attempts to defuse the situation. Finding neither Rufus nor Buck, the Major's group of 20 men settle for terrorizing the Hannassey women and children, shooting holes in their water reservoir.
